gloss: inauguration ceremony; launch ceremony; kickoff ceremony

definitions.gloss: inauguration ceremony; launch ceremony; kickoff ceremony
definitions.explanation: A formal ceremony held to mark the start of a new organization, committee, project, or system. Common for new government agencies, research institutes, associations, and corporate initiatives.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{委員会|いいんかい}の{発足式|ほっそくしき}が{開|ひら}かれた。
examples.english: An inauguration ceremony for the new committee was held.

examples.japanese: {市長|しちょう}が{発足式|ほっそくしき}であいさつを{述|の}べた。
examples.english: The mayor gave a speech at the inauguration ceremony.

examples.japanese: {研究|けんきゅう}プロジェクトの{発足式|ほっそくしき}には{関係|かんけい}{者|しゃ}が{多|おお}く{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Many stakeholders gathered for the launch ceremony of the research project.

notes:
Compound of {発足|ほっそく} ('launch; founding; starting operation') and {式|しき} ('ceremony'). The verb {発足|ほっそく}する means 'to be launched; to start operating', and {発足式|ほっそくしき} is the formal ceremony that marks that moment. Commonly seen in news reports about new committees, departments, councils, and projects.

USAGE:
- A formal term found in official announcements, press releases, and news reports.
- Typical events at a {発足式|ほっそくしき} include speeches by the chairperson and guests, an introduction of members, and sometimes a symbolic action such as a ribbon cutting (テープカット) or a group photo.
- The word {発足|ほっそく} is read ほっそく in standard usage, though はっそく is occasionally heard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発足式|ほっそくしき}を{開|ひら}く: to hold an inauguration ceremony
- {発足式|ほっそくしき}を{行|おこな}う: to carry out an inauguration ceremony
- {発足式|ほっそくしき}に{出席|しゅっせき}する: to attend an inauguration ceremony
- {発足式|ほっそくしき}であいさつを{述|の}べる: to give an address at the inauguration

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {開所式|かいしょしき}: opening ceremony (of a facility) — for the opening of a physical office or institution.
- {開会式|かいかいしき}: opening ceremony (of an event) — for sporting events, conferences, etc.
- {就任式|しゅうにんしき}: inauguration (of a person taking office) — centers on an individual assuming a post, not an organization being founded.
- {創立|そうりつ}{記念|きねん}{式|しき}: founding anniversary ceremony — held to commemorate an already-founded organization.
